mainEntity.name: Where can I find an English-speaking lawyer in Turkey?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cindemir Law Office in Istanbul provides legal services in English, Turkish, Russian and Chinese for international clients. The firm handles corporate, immigration, real estate, family, arbitration and cross-border disputes under Turkish law.

mainEntity.name: Does Cindemir Law Office serve clients outside Turkey?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The firm is Istanbul-based and serves clients worldwide with Turkish law and cross-border matters, including company formation, property, citizenship and recognition of foreign judgments in Turkey.

mainEntity.name: What international matters do you handle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Private international law, foreign company setup, FDI, residence and citizenship, tapu/real estate for foreigners, cross-border family and inheritance, arbitration, and recognition/enforcement of foreign court or arbitral awards in Turkey.
English, Turkish, Russian and Chinese. Contact +90 216 550 6775 or cindemir@cindemir.av.tr.
